<tr><th class="th"><div>Dec. 31, 2025</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_SubsequentEventsAbstract', window );"><strong>Subsequent Events [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_SubsequentEventsTextBlock', window );">Subsequent Events</a></td>
<td class="text"><p id="xdx_80F_eus-gaap--SubsequentEventsTextBlock_zBG7T3sIX0Pc" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; font-size: 10pt">
  <tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="width: 24px"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b>24.</b></span></td>
    <td style="text-align: justify"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="xdx_822_zfTiqTXArukh">Subsequent Events</span></b></span></td></tr>
  </table>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company has evaluated subsequent events for
adjustment to or disclosure in its consolidated financial statements through the date of this report, and has not identified any recordable
or disclosable events, not otherwise reported in these consolidated financial statements or the notes thereto, with the exception of
those noted below.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On February 27, 2026, Anderson Development SB,
LLC, a subsidiary of the Company, entered into Amendment No. 1 to its Loan Agreement and Promissory Note Secured by Deed of Trust with
Arbor Ranch SB, LLC (the &#8220;Lender&#8221;), originally dated May 25, 2023, pursuant to which the Lender had loaned the Borrower up
to $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_c20260227__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zODClq2U50j4" title="Borrowed amount">7,000,000</span>. The Amendment modifies the repayment schedule, providing for twelve monthly installments of $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPeriodicPayment_c20260227__20260227__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zjxtDvtd9FW5" title="Periodic payment">50,000</span> for calendar year
2026, totaling $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentPrincipal_c20260227__20260227__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_z6DsbFcjrz42" title="Periodic payment principal">600,000</span>, with the first payment of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentPrincipal_c20260315__20260315__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zeWTaIHIw312" title="Periodic payment principal">150,000</span> due March 15, 2026 (covering January, February, and March 2026). Normal repayment
terms resume January 1, 2027, and the Borrower shall make a one-time catch-up payment of $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--RepaymentsOfOtherDebt_c20270830__20270830__srt--StatementScenarioAxis__srt--ScenarioForecastMember_zN3h7b86OBge" title="Repayments of other debt">484,638</span> on August 30, 2027. The Lender also
waived all events of default existing as of the date of the Amendment. Concurrently, the Company amended and restated a warrant to purchase
common stock originally issued to James Shields on May 25, 2023, reducing the exercise price to CAD$<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--SharebasedCompensationSharesAuthorizedUnderStockOptionPlansExercisePriceRangeOutstandingOptionsWeightedAverageExercisePriceBeginningBalance1_iI_uCADPShares_c20230525_z0N7qHuoRDr8" title="Exercise price">0.30</span> per share and extending the
exercise period by <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingWeightedAverageRemainingContractualTerm2_dc_c20230525__20230525_zXXaIqgTnGWk" title="Contractual term">five years</span> from February 27, 2026.&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On March 12, 2026, subsequent to the fiscal year ended December 31,
2025, the Company announced the initial closing of an up to $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement_pn5n6_c20260312__20260312__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zOblS170gV5e" title="Private placement">8.0</span> million non-brokered private placement financing, with an initial
tranche of $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPrivatePlacement_pn5n6_c20260312__20260312__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zJUfeGqtGl5i" title="Private placement initial">4.5</span> million led by Mindset Capital. The financing consists of two concurrent offerings: <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardDescription_c20260312__20260312__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_z07NnQcx5U85" title="Share based compensation description">(i) units priced at CAD$<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--SharePrice_iI_uCADPShares_c20260312__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zXGM6SyJgJTc" title="Share price">0.25</span> per
unit, each comprising one common share and one common share purchase warrant exercisable at CAD$<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_uCADPShares_c20260312__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zPRz1TrpRV25" title="Warrant exercise price">0.30</span> per share for a period of <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingTerm_iI_dc_c20260312__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zbvIMBS4hrMl" title="Warrant term">two years</span>;
and (ii) preferred shares bearing a 15% annual dividend (10% payable in cash and 5% payable in-kind), convertible into common shares
at CAD$<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1_iI_uCADPShares_c20260312__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zMHYDBsYE8z4" title="Convertible conversion price">0.38</span> per share. The Company intends to use the net proceeds primarily to expand cannabis cultivation at its Salisbury Canyon Ranch
property to the full <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--AreaOfLand_iI_usqt_c20260312_zqsEuAJ26ui7" title="Area of land">179.9</span> licensed acres, with completion of full-scale planting expected during 2026.</span> In connection with the financing,
the Company appointed Jamie Mendola to its Board of Directors.</p>

<span></span>
</td>
</tr>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for significant events or transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued or the date the financial statements were available to be issued. Examples include: the sale of a capital stock issue, purchase of a business, settlement of litigation, catastrophic loss, significant foreign exchange rate changes, loans to insiders or affiliates, and transactions not in the ordinary course of business.</p></div>
